included_sections: Little Mac forward smash family including angled variants
Retained baseline: Snake neutral-B, Monkey Flip lock, Cloud fair trails, Chrom jab trails, silent core, Hero neutral-B/up-B/side-B, Ursula/Wilhelmine naming
verification_tool: tools/verify_installed_card.py inventory and sha functions; local packages only, main/card access not invoked
package_action: Reused the complete existing versioned package; no rebuild or artifact mutation needed. T-0042 installer changes stay in workspace tooling, not in the console payload. No unfinished runtime or asset source differences detected.

excluded_artifacts.reason: Research only, outside requested batch; no runtime/source changes packaged
Unimplemented, outside this batch; no new feature included
Protected; absent from package; installation remains OFF

build_cache: Pruned; no fresh Rust compilation/reproducibility claim. NRO byte-equal to baseline and T-0042 historical installation record. Future installer must use --no-smashline --reused-nro and refuse if card NRO differs.
device_access: None in this phase. Historical install record only; present card state was not examined.
user_tests: 1. After designated installation, boot normally. Global logging is disabled; absent pgwr_log.txt is expected. Stop on a crash and retain the new sd:/atmosphere/crash_reports/ file.
2. Vanilla controls: Pyra c00 down tilt, appearance and sounds, standalone G&W, and Mythra c00 side-B must remain vanilla.

3. On Pyra c06 and c07, whiff and hit grounded down tilt facing both ways on level ground. Judge crouch, articulated body, low palm strike, hand/hitbox alignment, no manhole or unrelated props, and no collapse/T-pose.
4. Compare stock R.O.B. down tilt as timing control: expected attack at frame 3, clear at frame 4, actionable recovery by frame 15. Record any timing or recovery change.
5. Repeat down tilt on both costumes, both facings and upward/downward slopes. Watch feet, sliding, floor clipping and recovery snaps.
6. Listen/watch down tilt for donor swing, impact, landing, one of four voice takes, effects and rumble. Record any missing sound or effect.

7. Test neutral, up-angled and down-angled Little Mac forward smash on c06/c07 using your normal smash input. Report whether the angled punches differ from neutral; routing remains unverified. Charge and release with your normal smash input; check the established shimmer wind-up.
8. Spot-check jab, forward tilt, up/down smash, grab, forward air and Cloud sword trails, Snake neutral-B, Monkey Flip and Pyra/Mythra swap. Report any regression.

9. On Mythra c06/c07 check neutral-B fireball, up-B spin and all side-B charge levels. Prior reported side-B defects (level 2 downward, level 3 failing) remain unfixed; distinguish them from new changes. Send sd:/ultimate/pgwr_hero_s_log.txt from boot if produced.

10. Fail on a crash, malformed down-tilt body, changed hit/cancel timing, vanilla-control regression, changed up/down smash or missing expected audio. Stop after a crash; send costume/facing/slope details, screenshots/video and crash report. A neutral punch for both angled inputs is a routing finding, not by itself a crash/regression.
